title: Harmony Diamond Chic Glitter Cardstock 8.5x11, 20 Sheets, Midnight Masquerade (706658)

comparisons.notes: Harmony Diamond Chic Glitter 8.5x11 20 pack Midnight Masquerade (NM 706658), $12.99, listed in stock

writeup: Harmony Diamond Chic glitter cardstock in Midnight Masquerade (model 706658) is $5.99 at Woot for 20 sheets of 8.5x11. It's 85lb/230 GSM, shed-free and works with most cutting machines. Scrapbook.com sells the same pack for $12.99. Woot shows only 2 left.
